author: Inside Edition
description: Marjorie Taylor Greene tells Inside Edition why she is undergoing a controversial anti-aging stem cell treatment not approved by the FDA in the United States. The firebrand former Georgia Congresswoman traveled to Dream Body Clinic outside Puerto Vallarta with her fiance journalist Brian Glenn for her second treatment that touts stem cells to reverse aging. Greene says she does not have health insurance. She says she chooses to spend her money on preventative care like the stem cell IV which costs $4,000.
title: Marjorie Taylor Greene Speaks Out About Undergoing Stem Cell Treatment To Reverse Aging

author: Inside Edition
description: Many teens and college students are complaining that it feels nearly impossible to get hired. Last summer, teen jobs plunged by more than 25% from a year earlier. This summer, camp counselor job postings are down nearly 30% from last year. Andy Challenger, an expert in workplace trends, spoke with Inside Edition. He says that many jobs are filling spots by word of mouth. Challenger recommends talking to parents and friends about jobs. Inside Edition spoke to some young people about finding jobs.
title: How Can Teens Find Summer Jobs?

author: Inside Edition
description: There is new insight into how Gilgo Beach serial killer Rex Heuermann spends his days behind bars. He reads books about serial killers and gruesome murders. Sheriff Errol Toulon runs the Suffolk County Correctional Facility in Riverhead, Long Island, where Heuermann is awaiting sentencing. Toulon says the man who had admitted to the murders of eight women can read what he wants. Heuermann's ex-wife visits him once a month and his daughter also makes sporadic visits.
title: How Gilgo Beach Serial Killer Rex Heuermann Spends His Days Behind Bars

author: Inside Edition
description: Sometimes our wildlife friends need a little guidance. This was the case in Butler County, Ohio, when a deer got stuck in a fence at Harbin Park. After the baby was spotted, someone notified the Butler Regional Interoperable Communications Systems. And they had just the person to step up and help. They said that Radio Systems Analyst Ed Strecker is known for his "country-living know-how," so he knew just what to do. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Ohio Sheriff Rescues Fawn Stuck In A Fence

author: Inside Edition
description: A driver wouldn't give up, even after his tires were blown out and his high-speed chase with police came to a crawl. When it ended cops were shocked to find children in the back seat. Police pursued the vehicle through Riverside County. One patrol vehicle attempted to stop the chase with a PIT maneuver, but it wasn't enough to disable the fleeing vehicle. Cops chased the car for several more minutes until a spike strip was placed on the road. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: PIT Maneuver Ends High-Speed Chase, Cops Find Children In Back Of Fleeing Car
